profile.reasoning: Tariq Reyes is a highly accomplished product manager with a solid track record at established athletic apparel companies, most notably ASICS. He spent the last 10+ years focused on mobile-first experiences, specifically within the fitness and wellness space. He's now actively pivoting towards the AI sector, recognizing the transformative potential of AI in personalization and performance optimization – areas he’s already deeply familiar with from his work on data-driven fitness apps. He's *not* looking for a simple 'PM at AI company' role; he wants to leverage his existing experience to build and launch AI-powered products that have a tangible impact on user behavior and outcomes. He’s particularly interested in startups applying AI to areas like personalized training, recovery optimization, or biomechanical analysis. He’s comfortable with the ambiguity of a startup but wants to avoid companies that are purely 'AI for AI's sake' – he needs a clear problem space and user focus. He's a data-driven leader with strong analytical skills and a passion for user-centric design. A distinctive career detail is his side project building a personalized running gait analysis tool using open-source machine learning libraries - this demonstrates initiative and a practical understanding of AI.
profile.positioning: A seasoned product leader with over a decade of experience building and scaling mobile-first products in the fitness and wellness industry, I am now focused on applying my expertise to the exciting world of Artificial Intelligence. My career has been defined by a relentless pursuit of user-centric innovation, translating complex data into actionable insights, and driving significant growth through strategic product development. At ASICS, I spearheaded the launch of several key features within their Runkeeper app, resulting in a 20% increase in user engagement and a 15% boost in subscription revenue. I'm passionate about leveraging AI to personalize experiences, optimize performance, and empower individuals to achieve their fitness goals. I'm actively seeking a challenging and impactful role at an AI-native startup where I can contribute to building the future of personalized wellness.
profile.background:
• **ASICS**, Digital Product Manager (2016 – 2023)
    ◦ Led product strategy and execution for key features within the Runkeeper mobile application (iOS & Android).
    ◦ Managed cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, and data science.
    ◦ Conducted extensive user research, A/B testing, and data analysis to inform product decisions.
    ◦ Successfully launched personalized training plans, resulting in a 20% increase in user engagement.
    ◦ Oversaw the integration of wearable device data (Garmin, Fitbit, Apple Watch) into the Runkeeper platform.
    ◦ Increased subscription revenue by 15% through targeted feature releases and pricing optimizations.
• **Under Armour**, Associate Product Manager (2014 – 2016)
    ◦ Supported the development and launch of the MapMyFitness mobile application.
    ◦ Conducted competitive analysis and market research to identify new product opportunities.
    ◦ Collaborated with engineers to define and prioritize product requirements.
• **Education:**
    ◦ **Stanford University**, MBA (2012 – 2014)
    ◦ **University of California, Berkeley**, BS in Computer Science (2008 – 2012)
• **Skills:** Product Strategy, Product Roadmapping, Agile Development, User Research, A/B Testing, Data Analysis (SQL, Python), Mobile Product Development (iOS, Android), Wearable Technology Integration, Machine Learning (basic understanding), User Interface (UI) / User Experience (UX) Design.
profile.lookingFor:
• **Role:** Head of Product, Product Lead, or Founding PM at an early-stage (Seed - Series A) AI startup.
• **Industry Focus:** AI applications in fitness, wellness, sports performance, or biomechanics.
• **Company Stage:** Seed to Series A – I want to be a key contributor in shaping the product vision and strategy.
• **Team:** Collaborative, passionate, and data-driven team with a strong technical foundation.
• **Impact:** Opportunity to build and launch AI-powered products that have a measurable impact on user behavior and outcomes.
profile.notes: Tariq is highly motivated to transition into the AI space, but he's not a 'generalist' PM looking to learn AI on the job. He’s actively building his AI skillset (see background - side project). Caution: He will likely dismiss opportunities that lack a clear user problem or seem overly focused on technology for technology’s sake. Note: He’s a strong advocate for data-driven decision-making and will push back on decisions not supported by evidence. Important: He has a strong network within the athletic apparel industry and may be a valuable connector for partnerships or market insights. He's comfortable with ambiguity but needs to see a clear path to impact.
profile.locationAvailability: I am currently based in the San Francisco Bay Area and am open to opportunities within the region. I am also receptive to remote roles and willing to travel as needed. I'm not actively seeking relocation at this time, but would consider it for the right opportunity. Hybrid work arrangements are preferred.
profile.introPreferences:
• **Hard Requirements:** Introductions should be to founders or hiring managers at AI startups aligned with my industry focus (fitness/wellness/sports). 
• **Soft Preferences:** Introductions should highlight my experience building and scaling mobile products, my data-driven approach, and my passion for AI.
• **Avoid:** Introductions to recruiters specializing in general PM roles or companies that are not clearly focused on AI. Do *not* introduce me to roles that are purely execution-focused – I’m looking for leadership opportunities.
Please keep initial outreach concise and focused on the company’s mission and how my skills could contribute.
profile.personalPreferences: I'm most responsive to messages on LinkedIn. Email is fine for follow-up, but LinkedIn is my preferred platform for initial contact. I enjoy discussing the intersection of AI and fitness, so feel free to share relevant articles or insights!
profile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: I am flexible with scheduling and happy to use Calendly or Google Calendar to coordinate meetings. Please provide a brief agenda in advance so I can prepare.
